title: 第10章 天牢暴动！
novel_title: 镇守魔教圣女？我一天涨一年功力
content_zh:
王校尉死后，天牢丁字号并没有乱。

    相反，这里迎来了一位“大善人”。

    新来的校尉姓李，是个笑面虎。

    长得慈眉善目，见人三分笑，跟那个整天板着死人脸、恨不得把“我是坏人”四个字刻在脑门上的王校尉完全不同。

    李校尉上任的第一天，就给丁字号的狱卒们发了福利。

    每人二两银子，外加一顿好酒好菜。

    美其名曰：“大家辛苦了，以后都是自家兄弟，有福同享。”

    狱卒们感动得痛哭流涕，纷纷表示愿意为李大人赴汤蹈火。

    只有陈然，拿着那二两银子，心里直犯嘀咕。

    “无事献殷勤，非奸即盗。”

    在天牢这种吃人不吐骨头的地方，突然冒出个大善人，这本身就是最大的恐怖故事。

    更让陈然警惕的是，这位李校尉对他似乎“格外关照”。

    不仅免了他倒夜香的苦差事，还特意安排了两个资深狱卒——何万和刘海峰，协助他一起看守七号房。

    理由是：“红莲魔女是重犯，你一个人看守太辛苦，多两个人照应，我也放心。”

    听听，多贴心。

    要不是陈然有【镇狱天书】护体，心态稳如老狗，恐怕早就感激涕零，纳头便拜了。

    但现在……

    这哪里是照应，分明是监视。

    ……

    夜深了。

    丁字号的走廊里，油灯昏暗。

    陈然盘膝坐在狱卒房的床上，闭目养神。

    何万和刘海峰则守在七号房门口，有一搭没一搭地聊着天。

    何万是个老油条，在天牢混了十几年，最大的本事就是偷奸耍滑。

    而刘海峰……

    陈然微微睁开眼，目光透过门缝，落在那个有些焦躁的身影上。

    刘海峰是个年轻人，入职不到三年。

    平日里沉默寡言，但这几天，他有点不对劲。

    眼神飘忽，坐立不安，时不时还往陈然这边瞟一眼，像是在防备什么。

    “陈哥。”

    就在这时，刘海峰突然走了过来，站在门口，搓着手，一脸讨好。

    “还没睡呢？”

    陈然睁开眼，看着他。

    “有事？”

    “那个……”

    刘海峰犹豫了一下，似乎在组织语言。

    “今晚能不能……咱俩换个班？”

    “换班？”

    陈然挑了挑眉。

    天牢的排班是固定的，前半夜是何万和刘海峰，后半夜才是陈然。

    现在才刚过亥时，离换班还早着呢。

    “是这样，我……我肚子有点不舒服，想去趟茅房，可能时间比较久。”

    刘海峰捂着肚子，装出一副痛苦的样子。

    “你也知道，这天牢里阴气重，我这老毛病又犯了。”

    “所以想让你先顶一会儿，等我回来，后半夜我全包了，让你睡个好觉。”

    这理由，烂得掉渣。

    陈然看着他那双闪烁不定的眼睛，心里跟明镜似的。

    肚子疼？

    我看你是心里有鬼吧。

    不过，陈然并没有拆穿他。

    既然有人想演戏，那他就配合一下好了。

    反正他也想看看，这葫芦里到底卖的什么药。
content_en:
After Wang Xiaowei's death, Tianlao Dinghao was not in chaos.

    On the contrary, a "great good man" was welcomed here.

    The new captain's surname is Li, and he is a smiling tiger.

    He has a kind face and kind eyes, and smiles every time he sees people. He is completely different from Captain Wang who has a dead face all day long and wants to carve the words "I am a bad guy" on his forehead.

    On the first day that Captain Li took office, he distributed benefits to the jailers in the T-shaped prison cell.

    Two taels of silver per person, plus a meal of good wine and food.

    He said it euphemistically: "Thank you for your hard work, we will all be brothers from now on, and we will share the blessings."

    The jailers were moved to tears and expressed their willingness to go through fire and water for Mr. Li.

    Only Chen Ran, holding the two taels of silver, was muttering in his heart.

    "To show hospitality for nothing is to be either an adulterer or a thief."

    In a place like Tianlao, which eats people without spitting out their bones, a good man suddenly appears. This is the biggest horror story in itself.

    What made Chen Ran even more wary was that Lieutenant Li seemed to take "special care" of him.

    Not only did he save him the drudgery of pouring night fragrance, but he also specially arranged for two senior jailers, He Wan and Liu Haifeng, to assist him in guarding Room No. 7.

    The reason is: "The Red Lotus Witch is a repeat offender. It's too hard for you to guard her alone. I can rest assured if there are two more people to take care of her."

    Listen, how considerate.

    If Chen Ran hadn't been protected by the [Prison Suppressing Book] and his mentality was as stable as an old dog, he would have shed tears of gratitude and bowed his head.

    But now...

    This is not a sign of care, it is clearly surveillance.

    …

    It's late at night.

    In the T-shaped corridor, the oil lamp was dim.

    Chen Ran sat cross-legged on the bed in the jailer's room, closing his eyes to rest.

    He Wan and Liu Haifeng stood guard at the door of Room No. 7, chatting incessantly.

    He Wan is a veteran who has been in Tianlao for more than ten years. His greatest skill is cheating and sneaking.

    And Liu Haifeng...

    Chen Ran opened his eyes slightly and looked through the crack in the door, landing on the anxious figure.

    Liu Haifeng is a young man who has been employed for less than three years.

    He is usually taciturn, but these days, something is wrong with him.

    His eyes were wandering, he was restless, and he glanced at Chen Ran from time to time, as if he was on guard against something.

    "Brother Chen."

    At this moment, Liu Haifeng suddenly came over and stood at the door, rubbing his hands with a flattering look on his face.

    "Aren't you asleep yet?"

    Chen Ran opened his eyes and looked at him.

    "Is something wrong?"

    "That..."

    Liu Haifeng hesitated for a moment, seeming to formulate his words.

    "Can... we switch shifts tonight?"

    "Shift change?"

    Chen Ran raised his eyebrows.

    The schedule of Tianlao is fixed, with He Wan and Liu Haifeng in the first half of the night, and Chen Ran in the second half of the night.

    It's just past midnight, and it's still early for shift change.

    "That's right, I... I feel a little uncomfortable in my stomach. I want to go to the latrine. It might take a long time."

    Liu Haifeng held his stomach and pretended to be in pain.

    "As you know, there is a lot of evil in the prison today, and I've relapsed into this old habit."

    "So I want you to hold on for a while. When I come back, I'll take care of everything in the second half of the night so you can have a good sleep."

    This reason is so rotten.

    Chen Ran looked at his twinkling eyes, feeling like a mirror.

    stomachache?

    I think you have something on your mind.

    However, Chen Ran did not expose him.

    Since someone wants to act, he should cooperate.

    Anyway, he wanted to see what kind of medicine was sold in this gourd.
